verses.1: And thus the prophet, the seer, said to him: Now rejoice, O forsaken one, in the light of the hour; and behold, the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, will keep you, because you did not turn your face away.
verses.2: He said to us: My horses have grown weak, and because of this I have been delayed on the way.
verses.3: But you, do not be afraid of the men who pursue you, those who would destroy you; and do not be delayed, for the wrath of the Lord is upon you.
verses.4: And they said to him: Put on armor, and do not withhold from me the shooting of the bow, and strike him down, and do to him likewise. But he struck the armored one who did not spare you. The Lord, the Holy One of Israel, says: Rather, I will bring evil sickness into your heart, which is worse than the shooting of the bow, and its strike is a wound, and a grievous and incurable disease.
verses.5: And I will bring evil sickness into your heart, and you shall sin, and there shall be none to help you; and you shall not find a name, and behold, my wrath; and you shall not escape from my hand until I blot out your memory from the earth.
verses.6: And know that I am the Lord your Creator. When He had done this thing quickly, like the twinkling of an eye—for you stiffened your neck and lifted up your head against my city—for you are like chaff before the wind, which the fire devours before my eyes, and like dust which the winds carry away and remove from the face of the earth, so are you before me.
verses.7: For behold, my wrath; and you did not know your Creator, and I will not spare anything that is yours, and nothing shall remain that is exalted in all your land.
verses.8: And now, turn back from all the evil that you have done; and if you repent and humble yourself before the Lord with sighing and weeping, and plead with Him with a pure heart, the Lord will forgive your sins for all that you have done wrong before Him.
verses.9: And at that time he wept, kneeling before the Lord because of his sin, and he put on ashes, for the Lord had rebuked him.
verses.10: And he knew that the Lord does not delay the evil which He spoke by the mouth of His prophet; for His eyes are watchful and do not slumber, and His ears are open and are not shut, and the word which He spoke does not fail, and He does it in a single moment, like the twinkling of an eye.
verses.11: And he cast off his garments and put on sackcloth of hair, and he cast dust upon his head, and he wept and lamented before the Lord his God because of the evil that he had done.
